messages:
carla-b: follow-up from the postmortem thread. the auth/token issuer maintenance caused model-registry write failures and a deployment backlog. this is now the 4th auth-adjacent incident in ~9 months. posting a compact set of remediation owners and firm ETAs so we can close the loop. please ack and claim.

Tom-h: quick recap: incident triggered ~2026-02-11T03:05Z, token error spike ~18%, write 5xxs showed up within 2m, manual mitigation (suppress retries + drain queue) started by 03:18Z, fully drained by 03:42Z. pattern: provider maintenance windows align with big internal rollout waves.

oncall-ivy: ops note: reads stayed healthy; writes retried and caused DB pressure. manual backpressure and temporary queue helped but that required human ops time.

carla-b: proposed actions (reply with owner + ETA):
- vendor advanced-notice and contract clause for scheduled maintenance -> owner: procurement-li -> ETA: 12d
- shadow token issuer prototype (mirror tokens from secondary issuer + health comparator) -> owner: tom-h -> ETA: 3w
- write-through local buffer (bounded, idempotent) that accepts writes during auth degrations and applies when tokens healthy -> owner: tom-h -> ETA: 10d
- SDK defensive mode: allow cached-token reads, accept writes with 202 accepted & enqueue, and exponential backoff+jitter -> owner: tom-h -> ETA: 7d
- automated deploy embargo (CI gate) for vendor maintenance windows and a commit-size cap during embargo -> owner: oncall-ivy -> ETA: EOW
- observability: composite alert (token-error-rate >5% for 3m OR token-stall + registry-write-fail spike) + dashboard tiles -> owner: oncall-ivy -> ETA: 72h
- monthly "dependency heatmap" review to monitor recurrence & trends; include vendor incidents and our mitigations -> owner: carla-b -> ETA: create recurring now

procurement-li: taking the vendor contract + advanced-notice ask. will escalate to account team and request at least 48h maintenance calendar, plus a contractual clause for advance notice. ETA 12d for formal reply.

tom-h: I'll own the shadow issuer + SDK + buffer. plan: SDK flag PR in 24h, buffer prototype in 6d, shadow-issuer design doc by EOW, initial probe code in 3w. will link to TKT-10021.

oncall-ivy: I'll own the embargo gate + alerts. setting up the alert rules and dashboard tiles tonight, will add the pipeline gate by Friday. also adding a recurring monthly review calendar entry.

ops-bot: created TKT-10021 - "auth: shadow-issuer + write-buffer + deploy-embargo" assigned to tom-h, oncall-ivy, procurement-li. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-10021

carla-b: two prioritization notes: 1) shadow token issuer + procurement advanced-notice are P0 given the recurrence and operational toil; 2) buffer + SDK defensive mode are P1 quick wins to reduce immediate blast radius. if no objections I'll raise TKT-10021 priority and loop in PMs for roadmap impact.

tom-h: agree on prioritization. will post a short risk/benefit table in the ticket.

procurement-li: ack. pinged vendor account team and requested calendar access. will share any reply in this thread.

oncall-ivy: ack. scheduling a 15m sync Mon 09:00 to confirm blockers and PR links. update TKT-10021 if you reassign. :thumbsup:
